sections.description:
FEDERAL EMPLOYEES BENEVOLENT AND
FEDERAL EMPLOYEES BENEVOLENT
AND
GROUP INSURANCE RULES, 1972
(Amendments)
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part II,
28th January, 2013]
S.R.O.6(KE)/2013,
dated 24-1-2013.---In exercise of the powers conferred by section 23 of the
Federal Employees Benevolent and Group Insurance Act, 1969 (II of 1969), the
Federal Government is pleased to direct that the following further amendments
shall be made in the Federal Employees Benevolent and Group Insurance Rules,
1972, namely:--
2. In
the aforesaid Rules,
(i) In
rule 14 of the words "one year", the words "three years"
shall be substituted.
(ii) In
rule 20, in sub-rule (3), after the word "retirement", the words
"before attaining the age of 70 years" shall be deleted.
(iii) In
rule 25, after sub-rule (3), the following new sub-rule (4) shall be added.
Sub-rule
(4). Cash awards as prescribed by the Board of Trustees shall be paid every
year to the first three position holders admissible to the children of eligible
employee in connection with Essay writing competition in Urdu and English
languages separately.
3. This
notification shall be deemed to have taken effect from 2nd day of May, 2012.
